v3.h1: Windshield chip repair and replacement, arranged.
v3.lede: Chip repair is the job we do in our own shop, most often the same day. When the damage is too large to repair, we arrange the replacement with a glass specialist.

prices.lede: Chip repair is priced per chip. A replacement depends on your vehicle, because glass costs different amounts for different cars.

rows.label: Replacement, glass ordered to your VIN

blocks.heading: When it cannot be repaired.
blocks.lede: You deal with one shop from the first call. The replacement itself is done by a glass specialist we work with.

items.title: We check the damage.
items.text: If a chip or small crack can be repaired, we repair it. If not, we tell you plainly.

items.title: Glass is ordered to your VIN.
items.text: We do not keep windshields in stock, so your glass is ordered in for your vehicle. That is usually within the week, a little longer over a weekend.

items.title: The job is booked.
items.text: Your appointment is set for after the glass arrives, not for the day you call.

items.title: Finished on your appointment day.
items.text: Same day means the day of your booked appointment. We help with the insurance claim along the way.

items.title: Windshield ceramic coating
items.text: Rain and bugs come off easier.

items.title: The tint strip on a new windshield
items.text: Nevada allows film on the top strip of the windshield only.

items.question: Should I repair or replace a chip or crack?
items.answer: If it is a small chip or a small crack, we check it first and can usually fill and seal it before it spreads. When the damage is too large to repair, the replacement is arranged with a glass specialist we work with, with the glass ordered to your VIN.

items.question: Will insurance cover a full windshield replacement?
items.answer: It can, and it depends on your policy rather than on us. Comprehensive coverage is what usually applies. We can help you work through the claim. Bring your policy details when you call.

items.question: How fast is a windshield replacement?
items.answer: Same day means the same day as your scheduled appointment, not the day you call. We need your VIN to order the correct glass, so the appointment is booked for after the glass arrives, usually within the week, a little longer over a weekend.
